changelog: Fix: v3.14.0's Position History parser expected 13 tab-separated columns, on the unverified assumption that Position History copies out of the browser like an HTML table -- Transaction History's real behavior, not Position History's. Position History is a CARD layout: each closed position copies as a block of lines, a label on one line and its value on the next. Every real paste was rejected with 'expected 13 columns... found 1'. Rewrote parsePositionHistory() to be label-driven, not position-driven: a line matching '<SYMBOL> Perpetual' starts a new record, every field is found by its own label rather than a fixed line offset, and the optional Close All button / open-set exit-reason line are handled by elimination rather than assumed present or absent. Transaction History's parser was unaffected -- it really is a table -- and was left unchanged

Add: bitfunded_parser.php self-test (php bitfunded_parser.php, standalone CLI, guarded off when required by the controller) built from a real, already-verified two-position paste (this account's BNBUSDT and ZECUSDT trades) rather than synthetic data -- v3.14.0's own header comment claimed a self-test existed at the bottom of the file; it didn't, and synthetic column-shaped test data would not have caught this bug regardless, since the defect was in the shape assumption, not the field mapping. Also covers a block missing Close All, a block missing the exit-reason line entirely, and rejection of a Transaction-History-shaped paste

Fix: exit_reason is now optional at parse time (empty string in, NULL written to the row) rather than a hard parse failure -- CLAUDE.md v3.14.1 documents the exit-reason line as an open, not-always-present set; v3.14.0 wrongly required it non-blank

Add: BitfundedImportController::confirm() now computes r_multiple/risk_amount/r_multiple_source='recorded' for a matched row whose existing trade already has a stop_loss on file (risk_per_unit = ABS(entry_price - stop_loss); r_multiple = price move / risk_per_unit, inverted for Short; risk_amount = risk_per_unit * lot_size) -- flagged as a real, deliberate gap in v3.14.0 since stop_loss moved to the pre-entry form specifically to make this possible. Never applies to a new (inserted) row -- this importer never sets stop_loss on insert -- and never overwrites an existing estimated r_multiple on a matched row with no stop_loss on file. None of the 59 historical Bitfunded Altcoin trades has a stop on file, so none are retroactively affected by this release
Change: bfimport.php's Position History copy reworded from 'select the table' to reflect the real card layout; no functional change
